title_zh: 安排青年俱乐部可自愿参加的小项目

scenario.label_zh: 安排青年俱乐部可自愿参加的小项目
scenario.goal_zh: 把参与意愿与能力评价分开并约定提供可选择的小任务

context_zh: 虚构青年俱乐部的两名成年导师安排活动；不包含任何真实未成年人的私人资料。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: Should every youngster have to present something at the end of the session?

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: I'd rather ask about willingness first. Not wanting to present doesn't tell us what someone can do.

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: True. A quiet first visit can still be worthwhile.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Let's offer a small drawing task and a model-building task, with no requirement to show the result.

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: And anyone who wants to watch first can do that.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Yes. I'll explain those choices at the start.
